$description: Lumen semantic typography presets — v0.10. Composes primitive tokens into single bundles that components consume. Six role groups: display (marketing impact), heading (app structure), body (paragraph), label (UI controls), data (tabular numerics — Lumen's signature), and editorial (longform prose). Plus the eyebrow / overline / caption / micro / kbd / code / metric utility presets. v0.10 is single-typeface — every preset's fontFamily resolves to Satoshi, with role separation carried by weight, size, tracking, and OpenType feature flags (tnum, lnum, zero, calt, liga, ss01-04, case). Read 00-foundations/typography.md for the full vocabulary, italic policy, and per-platform mapping.

display.$description: Marketing impact tier. Brutalist scale; tight leading; tightest tracking. text-wrap: balance is applied via globals.css. Always reach for these at landing-hero and section-opener moments — never at app chrome.

hero.$description: v0.4/v0.5 brutalist hero — one-word brand statements ('SHIP FREIGHT', 'BUILT FOR BUILDERS'). Reserved. Use at most once per page. Pair with display.italic.accent for the optional one italic word.

2xl.$description: Landing-page hero headline. Pairs with body.lg for the deck.

xl.$description: Marketing landing default hero. Pairs with body.lg deck.

sm.$description: Bridge between heading.h1 and display.md. Card cover, modal hero.

heading.$description: App structure tier. Mid-weight, looser tracking than display. text-wrap: balance applied at h1/h2/h3.

h3.$description: Subsection. Apple's optical-size threshold — at 20px and above, switch to display tracking.

h6.$description: Smallest distinct heading. Form field-group title.

body.$description: Paragraph and UI prose tier. Size-conditional leading (lg looser, sm slightly tighter). text-wrap: pretty applied to body.lg only.

lg.$description: Lead paragraph, marketing deck under display headlines.

sm.$description: Secondary body, helper text, dense table cell prose.

xs.$description: Smallest body — dense table description column, helper text on small controls.

tabular.$description: Body sized but with tabular nums. Use in any paragraph that mixes numbers needing alignment (rate quotes inline in prose, ledger explanations).

lead.$description: Hero/section deck — descriptive line under display.* or heading.h1. Renders in text-secondary.

label.$description: UI control tier. Tight leading (≤1.30), tabs/buttons/form labels.

lg.$description: Large button, primary CTA label, large tab.

md.$description: Default button text, default tab. The most-used label.

eyebrow.$description: Uppercase tracked label tier. The voice signature of operator UI — short, declarative, system metadata. Two cuts: sans for human-facing section eyebrows, mono for system/state metadata. v0.10 — both cuts ride Satoshi; the 'mono' name persists for component-API stability and signals 'tabular tracked-out' rather than a separate family.

sans.$description: Section eyebrow above display/heading. 'OPERATE', 'NETWORK', 'PRICING'. Renders in text-tertiary by default.

mono.$description: v0.4+ system-metadata signature — '[•] SYSTEM V0.10 LIVE', '@ DIGITAL HQ', 'INVITES IN:'. Wide-tracked uppercase (0.16em) with calt off + tnum + case feature flags so caps sit on a tabular grid. The hallmark of the Obsidian Lime aesthetic — Satoshi-carried since v0.10.

overline.$description: Chart axis label, sub-eyebrow secondary uppercase. Lighter tracking than eyebrow. Renders in text-tertiary.

caption.$description: Photo caption, image alt rendered visible, helper text.

micro.$description: Badge body, timestamp, hint, tooltip body.

kbd.$description: Keyboard shortcut glyph. ⌘ K · ⇧ ⌘ S. Always inside a .lumen-kbd container.

data.$description: Tabular numeric tier — Lumen's signature for stats, KPIs, money, weights, ETAs. v0.10 — carried by Satoshi with tnum + lnum + zero feature flags rather than a separate mono family. Tabular alignment is preserved by Satoshi's tnum table; the operator-instrument-panel feel comes from weight, tracking, and the calt-off / case-on flags rather than a monospaced face.

lg.$description: Stat secondary metric, prominent table cell value.

md.$description: Default tabular cell — money column, weight, ETA.

sm.$description: Compact table — DRY-93H7 IDs, inline timestamps, dense ledgers.

metric.$description: Big-number KPI tier — the Stat primitive's anatomy. v0.10 — Satoshi at heavy weights with tnum + lnum + zero feature flags so stacked KPIs align column-true. Atlassian metric token role adopted into Lumen.

xl.$description: Hero KPI — landing-page revenue counter, marquee dashboard.

sm.$description: Stat compact — sidebar KPI, table summary row.

code.$description: Code tier. v0.10 — Satoshi-only. Inline uses 0.9286em (= 13/14) relative ratio so inline code runs visually match the surrounding body x-height (a holdover from the JetBrains-pair era; kept because it lands the same in Satoshi). Block has ligatures ON for prose narration; terminal/diff variant disables ligatures so operators read as discrete tokens. Tabular figures (tnum) preserve column alignment in line-numbered blocks.

inline.$description: Inline `code` in body. Relative size (0.9286em) holds inline code at a slightly smaller cap-height than surrounding body so it reads as 'set apart' without breaking line rhythm. v0.10 — programming ligatures ON for prose narration; family is Satoshi (not a separate mono face).

block.$description: Code block (snippet, sample). Programming ligatures ON.

terminal.$description: Terminal output, diff view, command-line samples. Ligatures OFF — operators must read as discrete tokens. Tabular for column-aligned output.

prose.$description: Editorial longform tier — v0.10 — Satoshi at editorial scale, looser leading, wider measure, ligatures + proportional figures on. Reserved for /blog, /changelog, /press, legal copy. Never UI chrome. Apply text-wrap: pretty + hanging punctuation in globals.css.

title.$description: Article title (blog, press, changelog feature). Satoshi at heavy weight; v0.10 — opsz axis is reserved for a future variant.

subtitle.$description: Article subtitle, section heading inside prose.

quote.$description: Block quote — testimonial, customer voice. Italic optional via display.italic.accent override.

display-italic-accent.$description: The 'one italic word per hero' moment. Pairs with display.2xl/xl. Renders in text-accent (lime). Reserved — at most one per page.
